title: Move it around?
body: Hi! I used 'timeful' a while back, but I have heard that Google bought the rights to it or something similar. In many ways, I think Google calendar is even more practical. The one thing I really miss however, is the aspect which let you move the events around in you planned day by simply dragging them to a slot that fit better. And that you could make a reminder or event larger because you suddenly knew that it would take more time. In google calendar, you have to go in on the specific event to change the times, which makes it a little harder to fit many events in on a day in short time, and you do not have the same overview when planning a tight-packed schedule.
